title: Deiva Vaakku
desc: Hamsaveni's divine power earns her respect among the villagers, whereas her brother, Vallatharai, tries to exploit her power for his personal gain. He goes to the extent of sabotaging her marriage.

title: Golmaal
desc: Ganesh, a young man, falls in love with Aishwarya, whose father is a strict man and does not approve of their union. However, they decide to marry against his wishes, but her father falls ill.

title: Shankar Guru
desc: A righteous man earns the enmity of his business partners when he opposes their illegal plans. However, chaos ensues when unfathomable circumstances disrupt the wellbeing of his family.

title: Uthama Purushan
desc: Raghu, a womaniser, tries to cheat on his wife with his new secretary. But, when he tries to lure her to a hotel, he is inadvertently roped into a web of crime.

title: Thalaivaa
desc: Vishwa runs a small business in Sydney, unaware that his father is a gangster in Mumbai. When his father is killed by a rival, Vishwa takes over his crime syndicate with revenge on his mind.

title: Dhinandhorum
desc: A couple decides to get married but faces an obstacle when the girl's father opposes the match.

title: Pengal
desc: A mother hides her daughter in an orphanage to protect her from the grim realities of the village. Years later, the daughter returns to rescue several women from the atrocious situation.

title: Pesadha Kannum Pesume
desc: Vikram, a habitual prankster, decides to play a prank on his lover, Swetha, by telling her he is already married. However, his plan backfires on him when Swetha's marriage gets fixed with another man.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: En Aasai Rasave
desc: A young boy, working as a street dancer, discovers that his mother is still alive, so he plans to locate her and reunite her with his father.
